question: Who implements retirement and broker?
decision: Infra owns worker/broker/retire. Apoio prepares profiles, candidateCatalogV2 and one-slot consumer in isolated source; no modifying the other branch.

question: When may the next job use capacity?
decision: Only after exact retained retirement ACK. Completed or uncertain/pending retirement retains the single slot.

question: Can actual profile commands use physical .runtime paths?
decision: No: V4 masks that root. Plan logical managedStateDirectory relative paths and proposed immutable public toolchain, preserve physical project backing and namespace guards. Mapper/driver/tool installation still pending.

question: Does ArtifactStore attestation prove worker storage retained?
decision: No. It attests local verified/fsynced artifact custody; storage_retained is asserted only in the separate bound worker retirement ACK.

question: Which source checkpoint is authorized?
decision: Reuse confirmed appc472/site14409/harness09d1 handoff, do not ask same confirmation or infer HEAD6935056/latestproduction. New packet needs own full-integrity/executable/profile proofs.

question: Is one slot global across all workers?
decision: One slot per node. Mandatory paired guard in same DB/transaction across legacy dispatcher and remote consumer. Missing schema/review/guard blocks rollout. Independent Akamai and Civo may each have one.

question: How recover a lost retirement mutation reply?
decision: Separate authenticated retirement observation with same bindings may read retained receipt or return uncertain/no_replay, never repeat mutation or cleanup. Interface still pending freeze.
